assertions.api_adaptation: Original #5 returns a rejected JavaScript Error Promise and a never-ready Promise. The real native EventSink wrapper starts the admitted factory synchronously, contains the actual PRIVATE_SYNC_LOG_FAILURE factory panic and polls the actual returned Err(ObserverRejected) future and genuine never-ready future on one bounded owned worker. Rejection payload strings are intentionally absent from the native typed ObserverRejected API; no detached failing task is substituted for a returned rejection. All #5 inference operations retain a real 1000 ms client deadline and exact SSE/status/request-id bytes. After inference, the raw before-close owner snapshot proves factory_panicked=1, rejected=1, pending=1, cancelled=0 and one real pending-future poll. The pending future is not dropped until explicit owner close; after close it is cancelled/dropped, pending/charged bytes are zero and the worker is joined. Default pending timeout stays disabled.
